description: Presidential Secretariat - Public Security Ordinance Bringing into Operation, was approved by Parliament on 27.06.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval of a proclamation made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, bringing Part II of the Ordinance into operation. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving the implementation of statutory provisions under existing legislation, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
